title: From (Hidden) Symmetries to Stealth Solutions
summary: In a recent paper, Arxiv:2605.23077, we have demonstrated that (conformal) Killing vectors give rise to stealth vector solutions of a specific bumblebee-type Proca theory supplemented by fine tuned curvature terms. Here we show that such a construction readily generalizes to hidden symmetries encoded in (conformal) Killing-Yano tensors, giving rise to the corresponding p-form stealth solutions.
